text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our intense summer camp experience
has come to
an end...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This reluctance to leave is a feeling I
doubt I'll
ever get used to. I experienced
it last year as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I'd like to return here
someday...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah, it appears the bus has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Shall we head back to the academy,
then,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that summer camp's over, the
Mainichi Okan
is fast approaching.
